prompts.text: 🎵 Never gonna give you up — never gonna let you down…
🎵 Just a small town girl, livin' in a lonely world…
🎵 I want it that way — tell me why…
🎵 Bills, bills, bills — what you gonna do with all that money?
🎵 Don't stop believin' — hold on to that feelin'…
🎵 It's gonna be May — wait, it's gonna be MAY!…
🎵 We will, we will rock you…
🎵 Hips don't lie — no, no, don't stop…
🎵 All I wanna do is zoom-a-zoom-zoom-zoom and a boom-boom…
🎵 Livin' on a prayer — take my hand, we'll make it, I swear…
🎵 Wake me up before you go-go…
